38 04.04.2025 rrc IN THE HIGH COURT AT CALCUTTA CRIMINAL MISCELLANEOUS JURISDICTION CRM (DB) 1010 of 2025 In Re:- An application for bail under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 in connection with Nakashipara Police Station Case No. 337 of 2024 dated 09.04.2024 under Sections 498A/323/376/34 of the Indian Penal Code read with Sections 3/4 of DP Act.
And In Re : xxxxx .....Petitioner Mr. Avijit Ganguly ..........for the Petitioner Learned advocate for the petitioner submits that the case pertains to offence under Sections 498A/323/376/34 of the Indian Penal Code and as such the matter needs to be released from the list of this Court.
In view of such submissions, due to want of determination, the present application is released from the list of this Court.
Let it be placed before the appropriate Bench having determination as per convenience of the Hon'ble Bench.

(Bivas Pattanayak, J.)
